text:
Priya: Hey everyone, quick onboarding tax/benefits questions before my first paycheck. 1) When can I enroll in the 401(k)? 2) Is there a pre-tax commuter benefit and how do I sign up? 3) I have storage unit receipts from the move 10 can I expense those as relocation? Also my direct deposit didn't save in the portal 10 who should I ping?

Sam (People Ops): Welcome Priya! :tada: Quick answers: 401(k) enrollment opens after 60 days for new hires (you'll get an email with provider link). Commuter benefits are available to US employees via the Transit & Parking pre-tax account 10 you can enroll in the benefits portal during your initial enrollment window.

Ivy (Benefits): Adding detail: 401(k) auto-enrollment is optional; we send the Vanguard link on day 60 and you can opt in/out. Employer match vests per the schedule in the handbook. For commuter: set monthly contribution amount in the portal. Transit and Parking contributions are taken pre-tax each payroll.

Priya: For the storage receipts 10 they're temporary (2 weeks) while between leases. My offer included a relocation allowance but not specific line items. Should I submit as "Relocation - Storage" or as regular expense?

Carlos (Payroll): Submit storage receipts via Expensely with expense type "Relocation" and add a note: "TEMP STORAGE - <offerID>". Finance approves line-item eligibility; payroll will reimburse on next cycle after approval. If part of a lump relocation allowance, it'll be paid as a reimbursement. If you were given a one-time relocation lump, check your offer letter and include that in the submission.

Priya: Got it. My direct deposit attempt failed with error "routing number not found". Is it safe to email my bank details to payroll?

Carlos (Payroll): Do not email bank details in plain text. Use the payroll portal secure upload under Banking > Add Account. If that errors, open a secure ticket to payroll@redwood.example with subject: "SECURE BANK UPLOAD - Priya - <offerID>" and attach the bank verification PDF. We'll prioritize if you tag it urgent before payday cutoff (48h).

Priya: Thanks. About taxes: I filled W-4 with single but want to change allowances for married filing jointly. Can I update retroactively?

Sam (People Ops): You can update W-4 now in the payroll portal. Changes affect future payrolls only; we cannot retroactively change federal withholding once pay is processed. If you need help with the W-4 fields, DM payroll and they'll walk through it.

Ivy (Benefits): One more thing on commuter: if you sign up mid-month contributions are prorated that pay period. Also parking reimbursements require a signed lease or parking contract uploaded.

HR Bot: Expense submitted (ID 99210) by Priya. Status: queued for finance review.

Priya: Amazing, thanks y'all. I'll upload the bank doc and receipts, and I'll wait on 401(k) email. One last tiny Q: do US-observed company holidays apply on first week or are they pro-rated?

Sam (People Ops): Company-observed US holidays are paid from day one. PTO accrual is pro-rated. If you start on a holiday and are remote, you're still paid for the observed holiday. Handbook has the accrual table; happy to calculate your first pay period pro-rate if you want.

Priya: That's perfect, appreciate it! :smile:
